title: MulCLIP: A Multi-level Alignment Framework for Enhancing Fine-grained Long-context CLIP
abstract: arXiv:2611.34083v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models such as CLIP excel at image-text alignment but struggle with long, detailed descriptions due to training on short captions. Recent methods address this limitation using region proposals to align visual regions with sentences, but at substantial deployment cost. We present MulCLIP, an end-to-end multi-level alignment framework that directly exploits natural long-text structure without region proposals. Instead of simply stacking objectives, MulCLIP aligns different textual granularities through compatible training signals: global contrastive alignment for long captions and short summaries, Word-Patch Reconstruction over locally calibrated features for within-sample word-patch semantics, and Subcaption-Aggregated Patch alignment for context-rich subcaption grounding. translated_title: MulCLIP：一种用于增强细粒度长文本CLIP的多层级对齐框架
translated_abstract: 诸如CLIP等视觉-语言模型在图像-文本对齐方面表现出色，但由于在短描述上进行训练，它们难以处理长而详细的文本描述。近期的方法通过使用区域提议将视觉区域与句子进行对齐来解决这一局限性，但部署成本高昂。我们提出了MulCLIP，这是一种端到端的多层级对齐框架，无需区域提议即可直接利用自然的长文本结构。MulCLIP并非简单地堆叠多个目标函数，而是通过相互兼容的训练信号来对齐不同粒度的文本：针对长描述和短摘要的全局对比对齐、基于局部校准特征的词-图像块重建以实现样本内的词-图像块语义对齐，以及面向上下文丰富子描述定位的子描述聚合图像块对齐。在涵盖不同描述长度的基准测试上进行的实验显示出一致的增益，消融实验也证实了所提出的目标函数之间是互补的。
tldr: MulCLIP提出了一种无需区域提议的端到端多层级对齐框架，通过全局对比对齐、词-图像块重建和子描述聚合对齐等兼容的训练信号，显著增强了CLIP对细粒度长文本描述的理解能力。
en_tdlr: MulCLIP is an end-to-end multi-level alignment framework that enhances CLIP's fine-grained long-context understanding by aligning different textual granularities through compatible training signals, eliminating the need for costly region proposals.
